mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trusted_query.query_run ( tenant_id, id, assistant_version_id, requested_by, question_digest, quota_period_start, quota_period_end, daily_query_limit, daily_query_ordinal, concurrent_query_limit, accepted_lease_until, running_lease_until, status, answer, refusal_reason, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, version, created_at, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{id}, #{assistantVersionId}, #{requestedBy}, #{questionDigest}, #{quotaPeriodStart}, #{quotaPeriodEnd}, #{dailyQueryLimit}, #{dailyQueryOrdinal}, #{concurrentQueryLimit}, #{acceptedLeaseUntil}, #{acceptedLeaseUntil}, 'RUNNING', NULL, NULL, 0, 0, 0, 0, #{createdAt}, NULL )
